hook.en: An engineer wants to try ten different loads on the same network. Solving the full circuit ten times is slow. Network theorems replace the whole network with one source and one resistor.
hook.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಜಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹತ್ತು ಬೇರೆ ಭಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ನೋಡಬೇಕಾದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿಸಲ ಇಡೀ ಮಂಡಲ ಬಿಡಿಸುವುದು ನಿಧಾನ. ಜಾಲ ಪ್ರಮೇಯಗಳು ಇಡೀ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಆಕರ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ರೋಧಕದಿಂದ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Find the Thevenin and Norton equivalents of a network
Use them to find the load current

narration.en: An engineer wants to try ten different loads on the same network. Solving the full circuit ten times is slow. Network theorems replace the whole network with one source and one resistor.
narration.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಜಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹತ್ತು ಬೇರೆ ಭಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ನೋಡಬೇಕಾದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿಸಲ ಇಡೀ ಮಂಡಲ ಬಿಡಿಸುವುದು ನಿಧಾನ. ಜಾಲ ಪ್ರಮೇಯಗಳು ಇಡೀ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಆಕರ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ರೋಧಕದಿಂದ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: In a linear bilateral network with several sources, the current in any branch is the algebraic sum of the currents produced by each source acting alone. While one source acts, the other ideal voltage sources are replaced by short circuits and ideal current sources by open circuits (keeping their internal resistances).
body.kn: ಹಲವು ಆಕರಗಳಿರುವ ರೇಖೀಯ ಜಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ, ಯಾವುದೇ ಶಾಖೆಯ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಆಕರ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೊಡುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹಗಳ ಬೀಜಗಣಿತೀಯ ಮೊತ್ತ. ಉಳಿದ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರಗಳನ್ನು ಶಾರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆದಿಡಿ.

points.en: Voltage source → short; current source → open
Not used for power (power is not linear)

narration.en: In a linear bilateral network with several sources, the current in any branch is the algebraic sum of the currents produced by each source acting alone. While one source acts, the other ideal voltage sources are replaced by short circuits and ideal current sources by open circuits (keeping their internal resistances).
narration.kn: ಹಲವು ಆಕರಗಳಿರುವ ರೇಖೀಯ ಜಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ, ಯಾವುದೇ ಶಾಖೆಯ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಆಕರ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೊಡುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹಗಳ ಬೀಜಗಣಿತೀಯ ಮೊತ್ತ. ಉಳಿದ ವಿಭವ ಆಕರಗಳನ್ನು ಶಾರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆದಿಡಿ.

say.en: Here is a network: 12 volts, 4 ohms in series and 12 ohms across the terminals A and B. We want the current in any load.
Vth is the open-circuit voltage across A and B. The 12 ohms takes 12 sixteenths of the supply: 9 volts.
Rth is the resistance seen from A and B with the source replaced by a short: 4 and 12 ohms in parallel, 3 ohms.
So the whole network becomes 9 volts in series with 3 ohms. Now connect a 6 ohm load.
The load current is Vth over Rth plus RL, 1 ampere. The Norton current is Vth over Rth, 3 amperes.

body.en: Any linear two-terminal network can be replaced by a voltage source $V_{th}$ in series with a resistance $R_{th}$. $V_{th}$ is the open-circuit voltage across the terminals; $R_{th}$ is the resistance seen from the terminals with all sources replaced by their internal resistances. The load current is $I_L = V_{th}/(R_{th} + R_L)$.
body.kn: ಯಾವುದೇ ರೇಖೀಯ ಎರಡು-ತುದಿ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು Rth ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ Vth ವಿಭವ ಆಕರದಿಂದ ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದು. Vth ತೆರೆದ ಮಂಡಲ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ, Rth ಆಕರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದಾಗ ಕಾಣುವ ರೋಧ. IL = Vth/(Rth + RL).

points.en: R_th = resistance seen with sources removed

narration.en: Any linear two-terminal network can be replaced by a voltage source Vth in series with a resistance Rth. Vth is the open-circuit voltage across the terminals; Rth is the resistance seen from the terminals with all sources replaced by their internal resistances. The load current is IL = Vth/(Rth + RL).
narration.kn: ಯಾವುದೇ ರೇಖೀಯ ಎರಡು-ತುದಿ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು Rth ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ Vth ವಿಭವ ಆಕರದಿಂದ ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದು. Vth ತೆರೆದ ಮಂಡಲ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ, Rth ಆಕರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದಾಗ ಕಾಣುವ ರೋಧ. IL = Vth/(Rth + RL).

body.en: Any linear two-terminal network can also be replaced by a current source $I_N$ in parallel with $R_N$. $I_N$ is the short-circuit current through the terminals and $R_N = R_{th}$. The two equivalents are linked by $V_{th} = I_N R_{th}$.
body.kn: ಅದೇ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು RN ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ IN ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರದಿಂದಲೂ ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದು. IN ಶಾರ್ಟ್-ಮಂಡಲ ಪ್ರವಾಹ, RN = Rth, ಮತ್ತು Vth = IN × Rth.

narration.en: Any linear two-terminal network can also be replaced by a current source IN in parallel with RN. IN is the short-circuit current through the terminals and RN = Rth. The two equivalents are linked by Vth = IN Rth.
narration.kn: ಅದೇ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು RN ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ IN ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಆಕರದಿಂದಲೂ ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದು. IN ಶಾರ್ಟ್-ಮಂಡಲ ಪ್ರವಾಹ, RN = Rth, ಮತ್ತು Vth = IN × Rth.

caption.en: A source E with R1 in series and R2 across the terminals. Find its Thevenin equivalent and the current in the load.

tryThis.en: Check that IN equals E/R1: shorting A and B shorts R2.
Change only RL: Vth and Rth stay the same; that is the power of the theorem.

narration.en: A source E with R1 in series and R2 across the terminals. Find its Thevenin equivalent and the current in the load. Check that IN equals E/R1: shorting A and B shorts R2. Change only RL: Vth and Rth stay the same; that is the power of the theorem.

problem.en: A 12 V source with 4 Ω in series feeds terminals A–B, with 12 Ω connected across A–B. Find the Thevenin equivalent and the current in a 6 Ω load across A–B.

steps.en: V_th = open-circuit voltage across 12 Ω = 12 × 12/(4 + 12) = 9 V.

answer.en: V_th = 9 V, R_th = 3 Ω, I_L = 1 A

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A 12 V source with 4 Ω in series feeds terminals A–B, with 12 Ω connected across A–B. Find the Thevenin equivalent and the current in a 6 Ω load across A–B.

problem.en: Find the Norton equivalent of the same network.

steps.en: Short A–B: the 12 Ω is bypassed, so I_N = 12/4 = 3 A.
Check: V_th = I_N R_N = 3 × 3 = 9 V, as before.

answer.en: I_N = 3 A in parallel with 3 Ω

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the Norton equivalent of the same network.

heading.en: Thevenin is a Voltage in Series; Norton is a current in Parallel

body.en: Both equivalents use the same resistance. Thevenin pairs a voltage source with a series resistor; Norton pairs a current source with a parallel resistor. Convert with V_th = I_N R_th.

narration.en: Thevenin is a Voltage in Series; Norton is a current in Parallel. Both equivalents use the same resistance. Thevenin pairs a voltage source with a series resistor; Norton pairs a current source with a parallel resistor. Convert with V_th = I_N R_th.

points.en: Superposition: add the effects of one source at a time (linear networks only).
points.kn: ಅಧ್ಯಾರೋಪಣ: ಒಂದೊಂದೇ ಆಕರದ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ (ರೇಖೀಯ ಜಾಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ).

points.en: Thevenin: V_th in series with R_th; I_L = V_th/(R_th + R_L).
points.kn: ಥೆವೆನಿನ್: Rth ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ Vth; IL = Vth/(Rth + RL).

points.en: Norton: I_N in parallel with R_N = R_th; V_th = I_N R_th.
points.kn: ನಾರ್ಟನ್: RN = Rth ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ IN; Vth = IN × Rth.

homework.en: Find the Thevenin equivalent of a 24 V source with 6 Ω in series and 3 Ω across the terminals.

narration.en: Recap. Superposition: add the effects of one source at a time (linear networks only). Thevenin: V_th in series with R_th; I_L = V_th/(R_th + R_L). Norton: I_N in parallel with R_N = R_th; V_th = I_N R_th.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಅಧ್ಯಾರೋಪಣ: ಒಂದೊಂದೇ ಆಕರದ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ (ರೇಖೀಯ ಜಾಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ). ಥೆವೆನಿನ್: Rth ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ Vth; IL = Vth/(Rth + RL). ನಾರ್ಟನ್: RN = Rth ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ IN; Vth = IN × Rth.
